authority.applicability_source: normative-changes.json during candidate Planning; repo/authority/requirements.json after acceptance

assertions.predicate: Accepted repository-framework normative authority SHALL reside within repo/.
Each accepted normative requirement SHALL have one stable machine-resolvable identity.
The repository framework SHALL define Governance, Conformance, and Assurance as exactly three authority-bearing keystones.
Each keystone SHALL exercise only authority delegated by accepted repository-framework authority.
Persistent changes to accepted normative authority SHALL occur only through Governance.
Framework authority and product authority SHALL remain distinct.
Each planning-ready Design Proposal SHALL be maintained Markdown with one stable DP-NNN document identity.
Each addressable Design statement SHALL have one stable Design statement identity.
Planning SHALL bind every consumed Design Proposal to one exact and retrievable Design Proposal revision.
Each functional set SHALL select its bounded Design scope using Design statement identities.
The repository framework SHALL contain exactly one functional set identified as FS0-GENESIS with kind genesis.
FS0-GENESIS SHALL have no accepted framework predecessor.
Each successor framework functional set SHALL identify one exact accepted repository predecessor.
Each functional-set directory SHALL contain functional-set.json and plan.json.
Each Plan SHALL declare the normative changes proposed by that Plan without making the Plan the persistent owner of accepted normative authority.
Each Plan SHALL identify every repository mutation path authorized for its Build.
An accepted Plan SHALL authorize Build only within the implementation scope declared by that Plan.
Build SHALL consume exactly one accepted Plan.
Build SHALL NOT mutate repository paths outside the accepted Plan's authorized mutation set.
Build SHALL produce a machine-readable manifest of realized repository mutations.
Build acceptance SHALL require all applicable Conformance and Assurance obligations for the candidate realization to be satisfied.
Each active normative requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Conformance applicability determination.
Each active normative requirement with mechanical Conformance applicability SHALL resolve to at least one executable assertion.

An active normative requirement with Conformance applicability none SHALL resolve to no Conformance assertion and SHALL record a rationale when the absence of mechanical responsibility is not self-evident.
Each Conformance assertion SHALL identify exactly one accepted normative requirement as its direct semantic owner.
Conformance assertion identity SHALL remain distinct from implementation identity.
Each gating Conformance assertion SHALL be reachable from canonical Conformance execution.
repo/scripts/validate SHALL be the canonical public repository Conformance execution entry point.
Each active normative requirement SHALL have exactly one canonical Assurance applicability determination.
Each active normative requirement with required Assurance applicability SHALL resolve to at least one governed review obligation.
An Assurance finding SHALL remain bounded to its review case and SHALL NOT independently create or amend persistent normative authority.
Planning acceptance SHALL require all applicable Planning Conformance and Assurance obligations to be satisfied.
Build acceptance SHALL advance exactly one explicit accepted repository state.
README.md exists at repository root and contains the required Genesis portability topics.
AGENTS.md exists at repository root and contains the required contributor authority and workflow guidance.
LICENSE exists at repository root and contains the complete GNU General Public License version 3 text.
Each Plan SHALL define implementation sequencing.
Each Plan SHALL define implementation invariants.
Each Plan SHALL define validation intent.
Each Plan SHALL define Assurance intent.
Each Plan SHALL define completion conditions.
Build verification SHALL establish syntactic validity.
Build verification SHALL establish mechanical Conformance.
Build verification SHALL establish operational completion for the functional set.
Build verification SHALL establish fidelity to the accepted Plan.
Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect missing mechanical requirement coverage.
Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect invalid assertion ownership.
Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect unreachable gating assertions.
Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect missing assertion results.
Canonical Conformance execution SHALL detect assertion failure.
FS0-GENESIS SHALL preserve an exact immutable snapshot of every Design Proposal revision it consumes within its portable planning artifacts.
Each preserved Genesis Design Proposal snapshot SHALL be identified by a SHA-256 digest of its exact bytes.
Genesis validation SHALL resolve selected Design statement identities against the digest-verified preserved Design Proposal snapshot.
Each executable Conformance assertion SHALL satisfy the governed evidence obligations applicable to that assertion.
The initial commit of the derived FS0-GENESIS repository SHALL establish the root repository revision for post-Genesis provenance.
Post-Genesis repository provenance SHALL NOT depend on repository ancestry preceding the initial derived FS0-GENESIS repository commit.
Every maintained Conformance primitive SHALL resolve through direct or transitive governed provenance to at least one accepted normative requirement.

required_engine_defects: assertion bound to more than one implementation
gating assertion unreachable from canonical orchestration
implementation returning result for assertion it does not own
maintained Conformance primitive without accepted normative provenance
